allow: PowerShell(Write-Output "--- claude on PATH ---"; $c = Get-Command claude -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($c\) { $c.Source } else { "not found on PATH" }; Write-Output "--- local bin ---"; if \(Test-Path "$env:USERPROFILE\\.local\\bin"\) { Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\\.local\\bin" | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name } else { "missing" }; Write-Output "--- code CLI ---"; $v = Get-Command code -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($v\) { $v.Source } else { "code not found on PATH" })

PowerShell(Write-Output "--- User PATH \(registry\) ---"; $up = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\("Path","User"\); $up -split ';' | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' }; Write-Output "--- contains .local\\bin? ---"; if \($up -split ';' -contains "$env:USERPROFILE\\.local\\bin"\) { "YES" } else { "NO" }; Write-Output "--- version ---"; & "$env:USERPROFILE\\.local\\bin\\claude.exe" --version)
